methodZh: 本次独立恢复批次仅续补原先未完成的 21 个任务/参数槽，已有 12 张静态图与 low/max 动画不重复请求。按默认动画、max 两道代码、default 十八道文本/代码的顺序串行。使用官方 Kimi Coding Plan 原生 Anthropic Messages，精确 model=k3.1-pro。默认动画原轮在 12,288 token 截断，本次独立重试提高到 32,768；文本/代码初次恢复上限 12,288，超时 600 秒。max_tokens 包含思考及正文；省略 temperature/top_p，不另设 thinking.budget_tokens。default 省略 effort：当前模型配置页写 high，而概览页仍写 max，实际默认强度未独立确认；max 请求 output_config.effort=max，既有非法 effort 被接受的限制保留，只按请求参数分组。429 立即停批；网络及 5xx 至少退避 60 秒。旧原始失败和已完成结果均不改动，跨时段复用不是同日整套重跑，也不用于稳定速度排名。消耗订阅额度，没有可对账的按 token 账单。输入 token 为 input_tokens 加 cache_read_input_tokens 和 cache_creation_input_tokens，输出 token 包含思考；不公开隐藏思维内容。
methodEn: This independent recovery batch fills only 21 previously unfulfilled task/parameter slots. The 12 successful static images and low/max animations are reused without new requests. Requests run sequentially: omitted-default animation, two max code tasks, then eighteen omitted-default text/code tasks. Official Kimi Coding Plan native Anthropic Messages uses exact model k3.1-pro. The animation previously hit 12,288 tokens; this independent retry uses 32,768. Baselines start at 12,288; timeout 600 seconds. max_tokens includes thinking and final output. Temperature/top_p omitted; no separate thinking budget. Default effort is omitted: the current model configuration page says high while the overview says max, and effective server effort remains unverified. Explicit max uses output_config.effort=max. The previous accepted invalid-effort diagnostic remains a limitation; groups describe requested parameters. Every 429 stops dispatch; network/5xx failures back off at least 60 seconds. Original failures and successes stay unchanged. Cross-period reuse is not a complete same-date rerun or a stable speed comparison. Consumption is subscription quota, not a reconciled token invoice. Prompt tokens sum input_tokens and both cache-input fields; output includes thinking, but private reasoning content is omitted.

samples.title: 鹈鹕骑车动画
samples.prompt: Return only a complete self-contained animated SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.
rubricZh: 长喙、喉囊和两轮车架可辨认
轮辐与脚踏转动，腿部连接自然
4 秒循环连贯，主体不出画布
rubricEn: Moving spokes and crank; coherent leg joints

messages.content: Return only a complete self-contained animated SVG with viewBox="0 0 800 600". Draw a recognizable pelican riding a bicycle: long bill and throat pouch, two wheels, connected frame, saddle and handlebar. Animate rotating wheel spokes and a rotating crank with pedaling legs that remain attached to the rider and pedals. Use SVG SMIL animateTransform/animate/animateMotion only (no CSS animation), with a seamless 4-second repeating loop. Keep the whole bicycle and bird on the canvas. Use a light background. No scripts, foreignObject, external assets, external fonts or embedded images. Use only local SVG shapes and text. The animation must visibly move, not just contain animation tags.

trials.assessmentZh: 长喙、喉囊和两轮车架清楚，翼端接把手，双蹼足跟随腿端踏板，全鸟全车在画布内。轮辐和曲柄每4秒转一周，40帧均不同；实际编码播放跨一圈未见明显跳变。腿段在插值中约84–85px，八段线性插值与圆周脚踏中心最大有约2.3px偏差，仍是卡通关节运动。旧首轮12,288 token截断和恢复第2次600秒超时均保留；第3次32,768预算成功，用时458.05秒，该槽三次请求累计1271.31秒。
trials.assessmentEn: The long bill, pouch, two-wheel frame, wing-to-handlebar contact and pedal-following webbed feet are clear; the entire rider and bicycle stay on canvas. Spokes and crank rotate once per four seconds. All 40 captured frames differ, and encoded playback across a loop shows no visible jump. Interpolated leg segments stay around 84–85px; eight linear segments deviate by up to 2.3px from the rotating pedal centers, so this remains a cartoon joint animation. The original 12,288-token truncation and second-attempt 600-second timeout are retained. Attempt 3 succeeds at 32,768 tokens in 458.05s; all three requests for this slot total 1271.31s.
